summary: Unprotected writes are not replayed after ambiguous transport or server failures; bounded authentication and rate-limit recovery remain available.
reason: A failed write may already have committed. HTTP method conventions and caller-supplied idempotency keys do not establish provider-side deduplication. Ambiguous failures accept only read-only methods or explicit read-only intent, retaining mutation-intent exclusions; the prior platform policy remains separate for bounded 429 recovery.
validated_outcome: The deterministic source audit verifies separate conservative ambiguous-failure and bounded rejection-recovery predicates.
